title: Three declared suites, cuda/long/optional markers, and a GPU-required skip that fails the run and the gate

suites.cpu-pr: -m 'not cuda and not long', CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=-1, GitHub Actions
suites.gpu-nightly: -m 'not long' --gpu-required on a lab GPU host, trusted commits
suites.release-full: --gpu-required with TORCHFDTD_RUN_CUDA_BOOTSTRAP_TEST=1 and TORCHFDTD_RUN_CPML_KERNEL_CUDA_TEST=1 on an idle lab GPU host

fixture.markers: pyproject.toml [tool.pytest.ini_options] markers and tests/conftest.py (collection rules, --gpu-required, optional prefix)
fixture.recorder: scripts/record_gate_evidence.py classifies skips via release_audit.gpu_required_skips; scripts/check_release_gates.py rejects evidence with such skips
fixture.synthetic_policy_tests: tests/test_suite_policy.py runs tests/conftest.py on a synthetic module under pytester with CUDA hidden
fixture.marker_validation_on_2026_09_22: pytest -m cuda with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=-1: 603 skipped, 0 passed, 0 failed (no CPU test carries the cuda marker); the cpu-pr suite with CUDA hidden is run separately and its skip reasons are recorded in the handoff

reference_method: behavioural specification: injected JUnit reports and synthetic test modules with known outcomes

observables.name: marker_selection
observables.definition: which synthetic tests carry the cuda marker

observables.name: gpu_required_outcomes
observables.definition: passed/skipped/failed/error counts and JUnit messages under --gpu-required with CUDA hidden

observables.name: recorder_state
observables.definition: verification_state assigned to a run whose JUnit contains a CUDA skip

observables.name: judge_exit
observables.definition: exit status of check_release_gates on such evidence

acceptance.markers: explicit cuda marker, CUDA skipif reason, CUDA parameter with a gate idiom and an unconditional gate call are marked; conditional gates, CPU parameters and gate-free CUDA parameters are not
acceptance.gpu_required: a CUDA-reason skip or any skip of a cuda-marked test becomes a failure (or a setup error for skipif); optional tests keep skipping with the 'optional platform check: ' prefix; without the flag every skip stays a skip
acceptance.recorder: a CUDA-reason skip in a recorded run assigns FAILED even when required_tests does not list the test; an optional-prefixed skip does not; the judge exits 1 on such evidence and classifies evidence recorded before the field existed
acceptance.workflow: the CI job launches scripts/run_suite.py cpu-pr
acceptance.gpu_suites: refuse to start without a CUDA device (exit 2)
acceptance.source_of_limits: fixture-specific behavioural rules; no numerical threshold applies

not_yet_covered: a recorded gpu-nightly run on the RTX 5880 Ada workstation

notes: The existing G0-04 and G0-05 evidence hashes tests/test_release_gates.py and becomes stale with the new injection tests; those two tasks need re-recording after this change lands.
